Capitals hoping things ‘snowball' after Ovechkin’s first goal of season
NHL player poll names breakout stars in action during Frozen Frenzy
Ovechkin celebrates 930 goals with golden ticket to 9:30 Club

away.summary: The Canadiens held a practice session on Monday ahead of back-to-back games against Buffalo and Washington. Oliver Kapanen and Mike Matheson were absent for therapy days, but no injury or illness details were provided. The team is preparing for their upcoming matchup with the Capitals after facing the Sabres on Tuesday.

out.detail: under the weather and unavailable for Sunday’s game

home.summary: The Capitals lost 5-3 to the Kraken in their homestand finale, with Logan Thompson in goal. Pierre-Luc Dubois was unavailable due to illness, leading to altered forward lines. Matt Roy and Rasmus Sandin are on IR and LTIR respectively, while Justin Holl was recalled from the AHL. Alex Ovechkin scored his first goal of the season, and the team is hoping it sparks a scoring surge.
